name: Bloomreach Engagement
description: Bloomreach Engagement provides customer data, tracking, catalogs, analysis, campaign, email, import/export, and GDPR APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned private API group. Relay pins four project-bound operations: catalog inventory and exact-catalog reads run directly, while a bounded exact-customer property read and one-customer property update require approval. The update requires customer authorization and consent/subscription properties remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: BLOOMREACH_ENGAGEMENT_PROJECT_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Bloomreach Engagement project token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the project token bound to the dedicated private API group.

credentialRequirements.name: BLOOMREACH_ENGAGEMENT_API_KEY_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Bloomreach Engagement API key ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated private API group with only catalog-read and customer property get/set permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: BLOOMREACH_ENGAGEMENT_API_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Bloomreach Engagement API secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay uses this only for Basic authentication to the fixed standard API origin.

capabilities.label: Read catalogs
capabilities.description: Use catalog inventory and exact-catalog reads.

capabilities.label: Read customer
capabilities.description: Read named properties for one exact customer with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage one customer
capabilities.description: Update bounded non-consent properties for one authorized customer with approval.

allowed.label: Read Bloomreach Engagement catalogs
allowed.description: Read the catalog inventory or one exact catalog name.

approvalRequired.label: Read Bloomreach Engagement customer
approvalRequired.description: Read up to 20 named properties for one exact customer.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Bloomreach Engagement customer
approvalRequired.description: Update up to 20 non-consent properties for one authorized customer.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Project tokens, private API credentials, Basic authorization, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk transfers
blocked.description: Batch commands, imports, exports, customer collections, catalog-item traversal, and mass data movement are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer campaigns
blocked.description: Email sends/campaigns, events, analyses, catalogs/items mutations, GDPR deletion/anonymization, consent, subscription, and access-key administration remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only four pinned routes run on the standard fixed API origin; custom origins, arbitrary paths, queries, headers, customer structures, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Catalog reads run directly; exact customer-property reads and one-customer updates require approval, and writes require customer authorization while consent/subscription properties remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; customer authorization, fixed routing, field/response bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin/consent blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts four pinned project-bound Bloomreach Engagement routes with private Basic credentials kept server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Bloomreach Engagement requires a customer-owned project, least-privilege private API group, credentials, catalogs, and customers. No console, API group, credentials, catalog, customer, consent, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated staging private API group outside this worker with only catalog list/get and customer property get/set permissions, configure the project token and credentials in Railway staging, and verify catalog/customer reads, approval and customer-authorization denial/allow, consent-property blocking, asynchronous write results, response bounds, key rotation/revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.
